summary: CxReports is an automation tool designed for generating PDF documents and managing reports. It features a visual template editor alongside an API and built-in email delivery functions.
goodFor: It suits technical teams that need a self-hosted engine to automate document creation and dispatch reports via an API.
watchOut: The software is proprietary and lacks public release history or community engagement metrics, which introduces uncertainty regarding long-term maintenance and stability.
deployNotes: Since it runs via Docker, you will typically need to configure persistent volumes for your templates and output files, as well as a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
